Commentary.Commentary: Right then! That is all we have from this match. The deciding match of this ODI series will be played on Sunday, the 16th of December at the same venue, Sabina Park. That match will begin at 8:00 pm IST (2:30 pm GMT). The buildup for that will begin much sooner. Do join us then. Cheers!

Paul Stirling, the Irish skipper, says that this win means a lot and he is delighted to see how they responded after what was a tough loss. About his catch, says that he is lucky to have grabbed onto it and praises Andy McBrine for the way he bowled. Says that Craig Young has been bowling well and he is getting a lot out of the wicket with the new ball. Mentions that Harry Tector has been in fantastic form and he cannot praise him enough. About the decider, says that they have struggled to win a series in the past but they are looking for consistency from the lads moving forward as they have a lot to improve on.

The Windies skipper, Kieron Pollard says that they knew the toss will be a massive factor as there is a bit of moisture here. Adds that they found themselves in trouble again with the bat but this time, they couldn't recover in the middle phase. Mentions that there are no excuses and as a batter, he takes the responsibility too. Praises Romario Shepherd and Odean Smith for the way they batted and played their natural games in a tough situation. Informs that they haven't yet spoken about changing their batting order but that can change with time.

Andy McBrine, the PLAYER OF THE MATCH, says that the injury is fine and he is happy to be out in the middle. Adds that the wicket was a bit tacky so suited his bowling style. Says that they spoke about partnerships in the middle phase and is happy to have got it. Mentions that this win means a lot to the team given what has been going on in the camp.
... The Presentation Ceremony ...

Boy, Ireland sure will be happy with the rain but in all fairness, even without the rain, they looked to be right on top of proceedings. Paul Stirling and William Porterfield came out with intent and got their team the start they required. With a target like this, it's important to get ahead and then you can just knock around. After losing both their openers, the partnership between Andy McBrine and Harry Tector was the key. Tector then carried on till the end and brought up yet another half-century in his young ODI career. Pretty straightforward victory in the end for the visitors and there's all to play for in the final ODI.

The hosts were always going to be second favorites with the score they put on but they didn't do themselves any favors with the ball either. They conceded runs at a run-a-ball in the first 10 overs and even though they picked up a couple of wickets, West Indies were on the back foot as there weren't many runs to defend. Akeal Hosein was taken on today and couldn't do his job of stemming the flow of runs. He did get two wickets but it wasn't enough and the other spinner, Roston Chase bowled much better. But it was their pace bowling that just couldn't put enough pressure on the opposition and there wasn't much left in the pitch either. All in all an underwhelming performance from the hosts.

Well, these days the world isn't short of drama and there was drama at Sabina Park in this game as well. With Ireland in the driving seat, they lost their fourth wicket and just as things were getting interesting, rain played spoilsport. With still 73 runs required, the hosts would have felt that they had a chance but it wasn't meant to be. With the equation being just 11 needed off 28 balls after we finally got play in, it was Ireland's game and they got over the line with ease. Huge 10 points for them in the Cricket World Cup Super League points table and the series is leveled at 1-1!

There it is! Short of a length, outside off. Delany carves it past the diving point fielder for a couple. That ends the game. Ireland get 10 points in the CWC Super League as they win by 5 wickets! (D/L method)
Back of a length, outside off. Tector punches it to deep cover for one.
Gareth Delany is the new man in.

OUT! TAKEN! Back of a length, on off. George Dockrell goes for the pull but gets the top edge. The ball goes high in the air towards mid-wicket. Nicholas Pooran runs backward and gets a good catch in the end.
Commentary.Howout: c Nicholas Pooran b Kieron Pollard

Commentary.Commentary: Full and wide outside off. Tector drives it to deep cover for one.
Kieron Pollard brings himself on for what could be the final over of the match.
FOUR! Smacked away! Shorter, on off. George Dockrell goes back and pulls it past mid-wicket for a boundary. Just 4 needed now.
A single as Tector works it past mid-wicket. 8 needed now.
George Dockrell comes down the track and works it towards square leg for one.
Darted on the pads. Worked to deep square leg. 'Push push push push' says Tector but there is only a single there.

We will have more action! 4.4 overs will be bowled and 11 runs is what Ireland need to get. The players are walking out now. Harry Tector and George Dockrell take the crease and Roston Chase will finish the over. Also, Powerplay 3 has begun as this is effectively a 36-over innings.

Update 3:25 am IST (9:55 pm GMT, previous day) - Sadly, the rain is hanging around for a bit longer. Overs are going to be lost and D/L will certainly come into play. But for now, let's just hope the rain stops so we can resume play.

Update 3:05 am IST (9:35 pm GMT, previous day) - Live pictures from the ground show that it is a slight drizzle at the moment and the groundstaff might be taking the covers off and start moping. Also, the D/L par score currently is 131 but Ireland are miles ahead of it.

Update 2:41 am IST (9:11 pm GMT, previous day) - Oi. The drizzle has gotten quite heavy now and the players are off. The covers are on but as I type this, the rain has died down again. Shouldn't be a long delay. Ugh, more covers are being brought back again.

Tector survives a close LBW call! So close yet so far for Roston Chase and West Indies. This is pushed fuller, around off and the ball turns in. Harry Tector is pushed on the back foot as he looks to work it leg side. He misses and gets pinged on the pads and the hosts appeal. The umpire shakes his head. Review is taken by Pollard. UltraEdge shows there's no bat involved and Ball Tracker confirms that the impact is umpire's call. Even though the ball is hitting the stumps, the decision will not be overturned.
On a length, on off and worked towards short mid-wicket.
Quicker one, full and around off. Dockrell keeps it out on the off side.

Drinks break! The last wicket might make things interesting but the Irish should chase this down now. They have done all the hardwork and should chase it down with overs to spare. The hosts would look to trigger a collapse just like they did in the first ODI. An interesting finish coming up. Also, George Dockrell joins Harry Tector in the middle.

OUT! BOWLED! Is there some life still left in this match? This is pushed through quicker by Akeal Hosein, around off. Curtis Campher backs away and looks to play the cut shot but the ball just skids on with the arm and stays a bit low as well. Campher fails to get any bat on it and the ball crashes into off and middle. Hosein has provided the much-needed breakthrough for West Indies.
Fifty for Harry Tector. Is this the knock that wins it for Ireland? Quicker one, angled into middle and leg. Harry Tector is pushed on the back foot as he works it leg side for a single.
On middle and leg, kept out towards mid on.
On a length, around off and turning away. Tector watchfully plays it towards point.
What a beauty! Lovely bit of drift, into the off stump. The ball bites and turns away sharply as the batter is drawn forward. Tector is beaten all ends up.
A single as this is worked to long on.
Loopy ball, on the pads. Tector misses the flick and gets hit on the pads.
Shorter, on off. Tector works it to cover.
Flatter, on off. Blocked out.
This is poor from West Indies. Flatter, on off. Campher gets the inside edge to short fine leg. Pooran has a shy at the keeper's end but misses. There is an overthrow and the batters cross over.
Flatter, on middle. Worked to mid-wicket a fumble by Pollard and they get one. That brings up the 50-run stand between these two.
Roston Chase (3-0-9-1) is brought back into the attack.
A single as this is punched to long off. 77 needed in 21 overs.
Fired on the stumps. Tector goes back to block it.
Shorter, around off. Tector goes back and blocks it.
Flatter, on off. Blocked out.

FOUR! Lucky boundary! Runs are flowing in nicely for Ireland! There are cries of anger by Akeal Hosein now. Full ball, on middle. Tector goes for the sweep but gets the inside edge. It goes past the keeper and runs to the fine leg fence. 150 up for Ireland.
Full and on off. Pushed to cover.
Length ball, around off. Worked down to third man for one.

PUT DOWN! That is a dolly put down by Romario Shepherd! Short and on the body. Campher pulls it towards deep backward square leg. Shepherd runs to his left and stretches his hands out. He gets his hands to it but it pops out! Single.

Kieron Pollard takes the review for an LBW decision. Was it in desperation? UltraEdge confirms there's no bat on it. Ball Tracker shows the ball is sliding well down leg. So, yes it was taken in desperation.

NOT OUT! Full and on middle. Tector gets down the track to flick it away but gets hit on the pads. There is an appeal for LBW but it is too mild and the umpire too is not convinced. But Pollard decides to review this. No bat on that but the ball is sliding down leg. A leg bye in the end.
Slashed away for a single. Length and plenty of width. Campher frees his arms and slaps it to deep cover for one.
Back of a length, on the pads. Worked to fine leg for one.
Length, on off. Tector comes down the track and works it towards mid on. The fielder runs in but fails to collect the ball. It goes through and the batters get back for the second.
Good running. Full, on off. Tector pushes it to cover and takes off for a single. 5 from that over. Ireland are well on track to win this if they keep their nerves.
Over the fielder. Shorter and outside off again. This bounces a bit more as Campher looks to cut. The ball takes the top edge and goes over backward point for one.
Shorter and outside off. Tector goes back and cuts it to deep cover for one.
Loopy ball, on off. Campher gets the inside edge past square leg for one.
A single as this is driven to long off.
Loopy ball, on off. Blocked out.
Akeal Hosein (5-0-40-1) is back on.
A maiden over there. Good one by Holder. Full and on the pads. Worked to mid-wicket.
There is a slight drizzle. It doesn't look like it's going to affect the game but Ireland are 32 runs ahead of the DLS par score.
Length and around off. Curtis looks to run it down to third man but misses.
Nice and full, on off. Pushed back to the bowler.
Short of a length, outside off. Campher misses the cut.

Length ball, on off. Tapped to point. They want a single at first but Tector sends him back. There is a direct hit at the bowler's end and some of the fielders are appealing. They want to check if the bat for Tector was in the air. Pollard puts in a polite enquiry but the umpire says no.
A couple of overs ago, Romario Shepherd had left the field with what looked like an injury. But he is back now which is a good sign for the hosts.
Length ball, around off. Campher looks to run it down to third man but gets no bat on it.
Back of a length, around middle and leg. Tector tucks it away towards square leg.

SIX! That has flown! A good short ball from Joseph, over middle. Harry Tector looks to hook but gets hurried on. The ball flies off the top edge and goes over the keeper's head and all the way for a maximum.
Extra bounce this time! Joseph is bending his back here. Good-length ball, around off and the ball just shoots up after pitching. Harry Tector is taken by surprise and gets hit on the glove.
That one zipped through! A length ball at 143 kph and bowled from wide of the crease. The ball nips in after pitching and goes through the gap between bat and pad.
FOUR! Harry Tector is such a sweet timer of the ball. On middle and leg, driven straight down the ground for a boundary. No one's stopping that.
Huge shouts of "No" from Tector. Around the top of off, Tector gets an inside edge back onto the pads. Campher wants the single and it was there for the taking but Tector says no.
Holder hits the length hard and angles it at the body. Campher hops and dabs it down towards mid-wicket.
Beaten! Holder pitches it up, in that channel outside off. Campher is drawn forward but gets beaten on the outside edge.
Good running! Good-length ball, around off. Tector goes on the back foot and just drops it on the off side as he races through for the single.
Length again, around off and played towards cover.
Back of a length, outside off. This is dabbed down towards cover-point.
LEG BYE! Drifting on the pads, Campher looks to flick but misses. The ball goes off the pads and towards backward square leg. They get a leg bye.
Change. Jason Holder (4-0-28-0) is back on.
FOUR! Another lovely cricketing shot from Harry Tector. Slightly pitched up, on off. Tector with the off drive beats the diving mid off fielder and picks up a boundary.
Just sliding down leg, perhaps. A length ball, angled at the pads. Tector looks to flick it away but misses and gets hit on the pads. There is an appeal for LBW but not given.
There is a light drizzle on now but nothing too heavy.
WIDE! Well, for some reason the Windies fielders seem excited. Attempted short ball, down the leg side. Tector misses the pull and a wide is called.
Full and straight this time, Tector pushes it towards mid on.
A touch short and wide, this is tapped through cover-point for a single.
WIDE! Joseph looks to attack the pads but spills it down the leg side. Wided.
Good-length ball, angling into off. Campher hangs back and slaps it straight to cover-point.
Romario Shepherd is going off the field. Not sure for what but West Indies would hope that it is nothing serious. But he seems to be struggling while climbing the stairs.
Around off, Campher plays it late towards backward point.
Short again, down the leg side. It is there to hit and Campher pulls it hard. The ball rockets towards fine leg and they get a single.
Banged in short, outside off. Campher fetches it and forces the pull shot towards mid on.
On middle and leg, pushed towards mid on.
FOUR! Width on offer this time from Romario Shepherd and Campher plays a lovely shot. Length again, outside off. Campher just opens the face of the bat and strokes it behind point for a boundary.
A length ball, on off. Campher looks to drive on the up but mistimes it towards cover.
On off, kept out towards cover-point.
FOUR! Lovely timing! Pitched up, around off. Harry Tector leans in and creams it through extra cover for a boundary.
Good-length ball, outside off again. Campher looks for the cross-bat pull but bottom-edges it down to third man for a run.
That's a ripper! Well-directed short ball, right at the body. Curtis Campher does well to get his head out of the way.
Back of a length, outside off. Tector cuts it behind point for a single.
A bit sloppy in the field from Shepherd. Full ball, outside off and driven towards covers. Shepherd fumbles and the ball goes through his hands. The batters get an easy two.
A length ball, around the top of off. Tector looks to block but gets an inside edge. The ball goes nowhere though.
Length, around off. Campher is beaten as he looks to block. 'Campher, come on Campher' screams one of the fielders!
Full, on off. Campher blocks it from the crease.
Curtis Campher is in at number 5.

OUT! TAKEN! Straight to the man! One big hit, too many for Andy McBrine and Ireland lose their third! Short, on off. He goes for the pull but gets the top edge. The ball flies to fine leg and Alzarri Joseph takes it with ease.
Commentary.Howout: c Alzarri Joseph b Romario Shepherd

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Another boundary for Andy McBrine! Not the most convincing one though. Short, down the leg side. Andy McBrine shuffles inside and goes for the pull. It comes off his gloves and goes past the dive of the keeper for a boundary.
Nice and full, on off. Driven to mid off.
Length ball, around leg. Andy McBrine misses the flick and gets hit on the pads. The ball drops near him.
Full, on the pads. Andy works it to fine leg for one. 12 from that over and 100 runs are up for Ireland. 130 needed in 31 overs now.
FOUR! A boundary now! Andy McBrine dances down the track again and hits it straight back over the bowler. It drops just short of the ropes and goes over. Boundary.
SIX! Oh, that is smashed by Andy McBrine! Beautiful execution by the southpaw. He dances down the track, gets to the ball and smacks it over the long off fence.
Shorter, just outside off. Pushed back to the bowler.
A single as this is driven to long off.
Full, on off. Pushed to short cover.
Length, on off. Blocked out. Just 1 from that over.
Chance! Short, on off. Tector goes for the pull but gets the top edge towards deep mid-wicket. The man from deep square leg runs to his left but doesn't go for the dive. Single.
Good length, just outside off. Tector taps it to cover. Four dots on the trot now.
Length, on off. Tector looks to work it away but gets the leading edge to covers. He takes a look at his bat after the ball and signals that he wants a new one.
On a length, on off. Tapped to point.
Short, outside off. Tector goes for the pull but toe-ends it towards mid-wicket.

A bit of confusion! Tossed up, on off. Andy McBrine charges down the track and drives it to mid off. He wants the single but is sent back. The throw comes in to the keeper's end but McBrine gets back in time.
Shorter, around off. Cut away to point. Chase runs to his left but overruns a bit. But he sticks out his right hand to stop it. That brings about a few compliments by his mates!
FOUR! There comes the release shot and Andy McBrine has played that really well! Tossed up, on off. He gets low and sweeps it to the mid-wicket fence.
Shorter, outside off and coming back in. Pushed to mid on.
Dot ball as Andy McBrine plays a nice reverse sweep but straight to backward point.
Nice and full, outside off. Tector works it to long off for a single.
Akeal Hosein (3-0-23-1) is brought back on.
On a length, outside off. Tector gets the outside edge to third man for a single.
Play and a miss! Length ball, outside off. Tector chases it but the ball bounces a bit more than expected and zips past the outside edge.
On a length, on off. Tector blocks it from the crease.
Length and on the pads. Andy works it towards fine leg for one.
On a length, on off. Andy McBrine taps it to cover.
Length, on the pads. Blocked out.

Drinks break! This has been a good start for the Irish. They have lost their openers but a huge chunk of their target has been taken off. One strong partnership from here will take them very close to a victory. West Indies need to get a couple of quick wickets but they first need to stop the flow of singles to put the batters under a bit of pressure. Also, Romario Shepherd is brought into the attack.
A short ball, at 138 kph and around off. Tector sways away from it.
Good-length ball, over off stump. Tector gets right behind the line of the ball to block it.
Back of a length, on off and this is kept out on the off side.
Good-length ball, wide of off stump. Tector cuts it well and gets it through point. Roston Chase though moves well to his right from deep backward point and cuts it off. Two taken.
Banged in short, well outside off. Harry Tector goes over covers but doesn't time it well. He picks up a couple of runs.
A length ball, on the pads. McBrine flicks it off his hips to fine leg for a run.
Tossed up, outside off and this is pushed straight towards cover.
Nicely bowled. On a nagging length, outside off. Tector blocks it out.
Flatter one, around off. McBrine punches it off the back foot through covers for a single.
On middle, pushed towards mid on.

NOT OUT! Chase pushes this one wider and McBrine chases after it as he looks to sweep again. There is a hint of turn and McBrine is beaten. Hope whips off the bails and appeals. The third umpire is called in and replays show that the foot never left the crease.

Is that a wicket? The umpire at square leg has sent this upstairs for a stumping. Could be close. First, they bring in UltraEdge and there is nothing on it. Ooh, this is close. But it seems like Andy McBrine has his foot just behind the crease.
FOUR! Swept and swept hard! Floated, on off. Andy McBrine gets in position quickly and sweeps it well in front of square for a boundary.

Slight mix-up but no harm done. A length ball, outside off. Tector looks to drive on the up but gets it off the inner half of the bat towards mid-wicket. The batters look to scamper through but decide against it.
Length again, around off. McBrine steers it to third man for a single.
Good-length ball, on off. Andy McBrine defends it off the back foot.
WIDE! Spilled way down the leg side. Andy misses the pull.
A touch shorter, at the body. Tector works it behind square on the leg side for one.
Good carry! Slightly pitched up, outside off. Tector goes for the big cover drive but misses it completely.
This one is angled into middle. Tector looks to flick it on the leg side but gets a leading edge towards covers.
Odean Smith is brought on now. He had a great game with the bat but can he repeat it with the ball?
Shorter in length again, Tector hops back and tucks it away on the leg side for a single.
On a length, around off. Tector looks to reverse sweep but doesn't connect.
Beaten! Lovely in-drift from Chase. Nicely flighted, outside off and beating the outside edge of Tector's bat.

Risky single! Around middle and leg, McBrine drops it on the leg side and sets off for a quick single. Chase picks it up and has a shy at the bowler's end. He misses and McBrine is a lucky, lucky boy as he would have been a long way out there.
This is fired into middle. McBrine cuts it close to the body and towards point.
Shorter in length, around off. Tector eases it down to long on for one.
Joseph pushes it wider and Tector presses forward to stroke it through covers for a single.
Pitched up, on off and 143 kph. Tector drives it straight to mid on.
A length ball, around off. Tector gets right behind the line of the ball to block it.
Good-length ball, around middle. This is pulled hard and low towards deep square leg for another single.
Back of a length, outside off. Tector hangs back and taps it through covers for one.
Banged in short, around off. McBrine swivels and pulls it towards fine leg for a single. He can expect some chin music now.
Harry Tector is the new man in. It is time for Powerplay 2 now. 4 fielders can stay outside the ring till the 40th over now.

OUT! TAKEN! Gone this time! William Porterfield goes after a good start! Chase slows this a bit and drags back his length. William Porterfield goes for the drive but hits it in the air. It goes straight to Pollard at short cover and the skipper takes it with ease. That ends the Powerplay 1 and Ireland are at 60 for 2.
Commentary.Howout: c Kieron Pollard b Roston Chase

Commentary.Commentary: Shorter, around off. Cut away to covers.
Darted on off. William Porterfield gets the inner half of the bat to the left of the bowler. Chase gets across and stops it.
Loopy ball, on off. William Porterfield gets forward to block it.
A single as this is worked to long off.
Loopy ball, on off. Blocked out.
Roston Chase comes on to bowl now.
On a length, on middle. McBrine works it past square leg for one.
On a length, on off. Blocked out.
Full and on the pads. Andy McBrine flicks it past mid-wicket. They get two with ease and he wants the third but William Porterfield sends him back.
Short of a length, outside off. McBrine misses the cut.
Full, angling across off. Andy McBrine misses the drive.
Length, around off. Pushed away by Andy.
Shorter, around off. Pushed to covers.
FOUR! Another boundary for William Porterfield! Full, on off. He hits it in the air but wide of mid off for a boundary.
On a length, on off. Andy McBrine gets the inside edge past square leg for one. He is off the mark.
Full, just outside off. Left alone.
Length, around middle. Andy McBrine gets hit on the body while looking to block.

Short of a length, outside off. William Porterfield punches it through covers. The fielder chases it and stops it just inside the ropes. Pollard throws it back and the batters take three. 50 up for Ireland and this has been a good aggressive start for them.
Length and down the leg side. William misses the flick. Wide called.
A short one, around off and Andy McBrine sways away from it. A maiden from Alzarri Joseph.
On a length, across off. Pushed to covers.
Full, on middle. Turned to mid-wicket by Andy.
Length, on middle. Blocked out.
Short of a length, around off. Andy McBrine blocks it out.
Back of a length, around off. Tapped to point.
Alzarri Joseph is into the attack now.
Nice and full, outside off. William puts in a good stride to block it out. 10 from that over and the Irish are off to a good start.
Length, around off. William Porterfield gets the inside edge towards the keeper.
Length, on the pads. Blocked out.
In the air, but wide! William Porterfield lifts this length ball, just wide of cover. The fielder chases it and keeps it to a couple.
FOUR! An inside edge but William Porterfield won't mind! On a length, on middle. William Porterfield goes back to pull it but gets the inside edge to the fine leg fence.
FOUR! Top shot! Length and outside off. William Porterfield leans into it and simply lifts it over mid off. The ball runs to the fence.
Andy McBrine is in at number 3.

OUT! TAKEN! Gone this time! Hosein gets his man! This is a beautiful piece of bowling. Tossed up, drifting in and lands on off. It then turns away just enough to take the outside edge as Paul Stirling looks to block. Holder takes an easy catch at first slip. What an over that was, 15 and a wicket from it!
Commentary.Howout: c Jason Holder b Akeal Hosein

Commentary.Commentary: SIX! Oh, that is smoked! Akeal Hosein drops it short, on middle. Paul Stirling rocks back and smacks it over the long on fence. That brings up 5000 runs for Paul Stirling in ODIs, the first Irish batter to do so. What a player!
Full ball, on off. Blocked out. 'Checking front foot', says the umpire right away and it is a no ball! Free Hit for Paul Stirling.
FOUR! Wide of first slip! Loopy ball, around off. Paul Stirling looks to block but gets the outside edge. It goes past the dive of Holder at first slip and runs to the third man fence.
Darted on the pads. Stirling taps it out.
Full, on off. Blocked out.
FOUR! Clobbered away! Tossed up, on middle. Paul Stirling gets low and slog-sweeps it over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Back of a length, on off. Blocked back to the bowler.
Ouch! Full, on middle and leg. William Porterfield looks to block but the ball goes past the inside edge and hits him on the box.
Length, on off. William Porterfield misses the glance and gets hit on the pads.
SIX! All the way! Length ball, on middle. William Porterfield shuffles across, picks it up and pulls it way over the fine leg fence. There is a fielder there but he backs himself to clear the field.
Length ball, just outside off. William Porterfield covers the stumps and leaves it.
Length and down the leg side. William misses the flick. Wide called.
Length, on off. Porterfield blocks it well.
FOUR! Smashed away! Flatter and shorter outside off. Paul Stirling stays back and cuts it past point to get a boundary now.
Quicker, on off. Stirling works it to the left of the bowler. Hosein gets across to stop it.
Loopy, on off. Worked to covers.
Flatter, lands on off and comes back in with the angle. Paul Stirling is lucky to get an inside edge on the pads. He would have been plumb without that edge.
Well played. Flatter, on off. William Porterfield shuffles across and swipes it to deep square leg for one.
Tossed up, around off. Pushed past covers for one.
Back of a length, angling across off. Punched to covers.
Length and on the pads. Paul Stirling works it away past square leg for one.
On a length, on off. Blocked out by Stirling.
Length and down the leg side. Flicked down to fine leg for one.
Beaten! Full angling just outside off. William is beaten as he looks to block this one.
Nice and full, on off. William Porterfield blocks it from the crease.
Jason Holder to use the other new ball.
A single as this is pushed to long on. 7 from the first over.
FOUR LEG BYES! Good turn for Akeal Hosein! Tossed up, lands on off and turns down the leg side. William Porterfield gets a bit of pad on it while looking to flick. It rolls to the fine leg fence.
Paul Stirling is off the mark as he works it to mid-wicket.

Appeal for LBW! Full, around off. William McClintock looks to block it but gets hit on the pads. There is a big appeal for LBW but not given. The batters sneak in a leg bye. The replays show that the impact was outside off.
Kieron Pollard is standing at silly point and he is quite chatty.
Flatter, on off. Blocked back by William Porterfield.
Nice and full, on off. William Porterfield blocks it from the crease.
